title: Storage Rental Rent Accounting: Posting, Partial Months and the Rate Hold
content:
Storage Rental rent posts month by month on the storage balance, prorated in the first month and, where the product provides, in the last.

## Standard

**S1 — When rent posts.** Storage rent posts only while the rental is active, overlocked or notice given. The status that counts is the rental's status in the system record for that rental.

**S2 — Monthly posting.** Rent posts on the product's rent posting day for each month rented, at the rental's monthly rent in force.

**S3 — First month.** The first month is prorated by rented days over the actual days of that calendar month. The prorated rent is the monthly rent multiplied by the number of days rented in the month and divided by the number of days the month actually has, rounded to the cent. Days rented in the first month run from the first rented day through the last day of that month, both included.

**S4 — Last month.** The last month is prorated to the end date only where the product prorates the final month; the prorated amount is the monthly rent multiplied by the days from the 1st of the month through the end date (the last rented day), both included, and divided by the actual days of the month, rounded to the cent. Where the product does not prorate the final month, the last month is billed in full.

**S5 — Rate hold.** The monthly rent is held for the product's rate hold period after the rental starts. After that period the rent may rise only with written notice given the product's required number of calendar days before the increase.

**S6 — Overlock.** An overlocked unit keeps accruing rent.

## Status and rent posting

| Rental status | Rent posts |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Overlocked | Yes |
| Notice given | Yes |
| Reserved | No |
| Vacated | No |
| Cancelled | No |

## Worked figures (hypothetical rentals, each at its product's standard monthly rent)

| Case | Product and rent | Month length | Days billed | Rent posted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| First month, start on the 12th | Large Storage Unit (5x10), $85.00 | 31 days | 20 (12th to 31st) | $85.00 multiplied by 20, divided by 31: $54.84 |
| First month, start on the 1st | Standard Storage Unit (5x5), $55.00 | 30 days | 30 | $55.00 |
| Last month, end date the 10th | Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10), $115.00 | 30 days | 10 (1st to 10th) | $115.00 multiplied by 10, divided by 30: $38.33 |
| Last month, end date the 10th | Oversized Storage Suite (10x10), $165.00 (final month not prorated) | 30 days | full month | $165.00 |
| Any month while overlocked | Bike Storage Locker, $15.00 | — | full month | $15.00 |

## Rate hold at the boundary (hypothetical rental, 12-month hold, 30 days' notice)

- During the first 12 months after the rental starts, the monthly rent is held.
- After those 12 months, an increase takes effect only when written notice was given at least 30 calendar days before it.
